label: PROGRAMMING
desc: “Programming to me is the perfect blend of logic and creativity. It takes mathematical precision and uses it to create things that can be functional and beautiful in their efficiency, form, and elegance. There is something so satisfying to me when my code finally works: not only the gratitude of making something functional, but the knowledge that the journey never stops. Abstraction has no endpoint, and our job as technologists is to push it further, always building on our past selves, our peers, and our predecessors to make things more complex than anyone could alone.”
